title: Python: deadline-aware CAD and radio execution
description:
Integrate CCP2 execution into the existing drain/CAD path in python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py and radio contract in python/src/lichen/radio/base.py. Pass the admitted receiver channel/profile to CAD and TX. After each await or bounded backoff, recheck grant, receiver commitment, remaining complete-operation fit and legal/adaptive accounting. Preserve bounded contention and handle cancellation, errors and late completion without unauthorized emission.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: CCA already exists; this is a bounded extension of b7z9.29 mechanics, not a new contention framework. Reuse python.05/.06/.10/.11 admission and accounting results, preserving current terminal queue/back-pressure behavior unless a CCP2 requirement demands a scoped change. Do not make legacy roll-ups prerequisites. Preserve radio-owned identity, baseline SCHC and custody policy; audited OSCORE/EDHOC internals remain untouched.
acceptance_criteria: Drive the real queue drain with frozen vectors.04/.06/.08 and deterministic radio event traces. Assert the transmitted channel matches receiver context and no transmit call occurs after expiry, consumed slack, budget exhaustion or a conflicting RX commitment. Cover busy, clear, unsupported/error, cancellation and late completion. CCA clear and TX completion must not be recorded as delivery, and exhaustion must not imply SF12. Extend python/tests/link/test_link_layer.py; run pytest and ruff.
